meta.description: The person is viewing none membership.
checks: Nobody has two live memberships, across both payment providers.
The membership that counts is the one at the payment provider whose billing portal manages it; a live membership is always the one that counts, so nothing at the other payment provider ever hides it.
Checking machinery: the last change each payment provider told the product about a person is how their membership there stands.
A person has a billing portal exactly once they have subscribed.
New memberships start at one of the two payment providers.
With no connection, a person subscribes and cancels no further time. A billing period can still end.
A live membership's billing period is still ahead of the time at its payment provider. Ending one never leaves a due period behind.
meta.projectionReview: Confirm that omitted data do not enable an impossible stitched path.
